d:
Anant Singh Big Statement : bihar ki rajniti men anant sinh ke bayan ko lekar charcha tej hai. JDU se nikale jane ke bad anant sinh ne kaha hai ki vah sarkari aavas khali kar denge. iske sath hi unhonne patna snatak MLC sit se jansuraj pratyashi anuj sinh ki jit ka dava bhi kiya hai.
Anant sinh ke is bayan ke kya siyasi mayne hain? JDU se nishkasan ke bad unka agla kadam kya hoga? dekhie is riport men puri jankari.
Bihar ki rajniti, MLC chunav ke natijon aur anant sinh se juri har bari khabar ke lie hamare chainal se jure rahen.
